task.title: Introduction page
task.description: Build an HTML document from scratch: DOCTYPE, html with a language, head with UTF-8 encoding and the "Introduction" tab, body with one main heading and two paragraphs about yourself.
task.starter_code:
<!-- Lesson 1. Introduction page -->
<!-- 1. DOCTYPE and html with a language -->
<!-- 2. head: UTF-8 encoding and the "Introduction" tab -->
<!-- 3. body: one h1 and two paragraphs -->
hints: <html> needs a lang attribute, for example lang="en".

has exactly one

and at least two

.

questions.question: What is HTML?
questions.explanation: HTML marks up content: it has no conditions, loops or calculations.

questions.question: Where must <!DOCTYPE html> go?
options: At the end of the file
On the first line of the file
questions.explanation: The declaration is the first line, before <html>.

questions.question: Where does the user see the text from <title>?
options: As a large heading on the page
At the bottom of the page
questions.explanation: <title> sets the tab name. The heading on the page is <h1>.

questions.question: What happens after you edit text in DevTools and reload the page (F5)?
options: The change is saved to the file
questions.explanation: DevTools changes only the copy open in the browser, not the file.

questions.question: What goes inside <head>?
questions.explanation: head holds service information. The visible heading and paragraphs go in body.

questions.question: Which of these are closing tags?
questions.explanation: A closing tag starts with </. Writing <p/> does not close a paragraph.

questions.question: Why set lang on <html>?
options: A screen reader picks the pronunciation
questions.explanation: lang tells programs the language of the text: screen readers, translators, search engines.

questions.question: Match the technology with its job.
questions.explanation: HTML is the frame, CSS the finish, JavaScript the wiring and automation.

questions.question:
Match the part of

Text

with its name.
questions.explanation: Element = opening tag + attributes + content + closing tag.

questions.question: Which charset value does the course use? Enter only the value.
questions.explanation: UTF-8 supports almost every language in the world, including Cyrillic and Uzbek Latin.

questions.question: What is the file name of a site's home page? Enter the file name.
questions.explanation: The server opens index.html by default.

questions.question: Which tag closes the body element? Enter the whole tag.
questions.explanation: A closing tag is the element name with a slash: </body>.
